text:
maya: Heads-up — I pushed a dashboard draft for model+route token savings. link: https://staging.grafana.company/d/modelroute-tokenflow (please ignore styling)
jon: Saw it. Main token-saved waterfall looks useful but the model filter isn't joining to tenant slices correctly.
priya: Quick q — is `tokens_saved` de-duplicated across cache layers? I'm seeing numbers that look doubled for some Dedicated customers.
maya: Right now `tokens_saved = prefix_hits * avg_prefix_len` which is naive. We need to subtract overlaps with KV-level hits and any reranked tokens.
aisha: Note: kernel selection change in last release changed block size heuristics, so average generated seq length shifted. That can skew the `avg_prefix_len` and therefore the savings calc.
kevin: ops-bot posted an alert earlier: ops-bot: "prefetch-hitrate drop >6% on gpu-pool-3" — might be related to a kernel fallback we rolled at 02:13 UTC.
jon: We should add per-model / per-route / per-customer breakdowns with a time-shifted baseline and smoothing window. Also add `token-saved` percentiles (p50/p95) not just mean.
priya: Also propose a warmup-cohort tab: seeded prefixes vs organic traffic. Right now warmup coverage is global and hides tenant-specific warmstart gaps.
maya: Proposal: add a new panel `unique-token-yield` that hashes `prefix_key`, excludes keys present in a KV snapshot at ingestion, and computes de-duplicated token savings. That needs a small ETL change but will resolve double-counting.
aisha: Agree. Batching heuristics matter here too — if the runtime picks different kernels/batch sizes, request grouping changes and that influences observed reuse. We need to tag traces with `kernel_variant`.
kevin: I'll add kernel decision annotations to traces (kernel_variant, batch_shape, fallback_reason). Will push an instrument patch and a small backfill tag so dashboards can slice by kernel.
jon: Action items: 1) @kevin instrument kernel logs and trace tags (EOD) 2) @maya add deduping calc and warmup cohort panels + tiny runbook explaining negative-savings spikes 3) @priya run a short profiler to compare seq-len distributions pre/post release 4) @aisha validate token-saved calc against billing delta for a couple customers
maya: I'll also add a diagnostic sampling rule: when hitrate drops >3% for a tenant, capture full prompt/hash sample (redacted PII rules applied) for 30s.
priya: Good. That will help debug keying regressions (we've seen subtle whitespace/normalization issues before).
jon: tagging @eng-oncall to watch gpu-pool-3 and dashboards overnight. If we see persistent hitrate erosion, revert kernel fallback.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: dashboard patch deployed to staging at 4141592800 :white_check_mark:
aisha: Thanks — let's sync tomorrow 10:00am UTC to review the first 12h of telemetry and decide whether to promote the dashboard to prod. :calendar:
kevin: I'll post the kernel-variant trace example in the thread once instrumented.
maya: Thanks team — small, targeted changes should make the metrics trustworthy so PMs can rely on per-customer token-saved numbers. :thumbsup:
